title: Frobenius Structures on Tame Hecke Eigensheaves
main_claim: For SL_n (p>n), a dense arithmetic PGL_n-local system on a once-punctured curve of genus ≥2 over F_q, with tame regular-unipotent monodromy, admits (after passing to F_{q^m}) a nonzero perverse Weil Hecke eigensheaf with Borel level and parabolic nilpotent singular support. Its full multi-leg, fusion-coherent eigenstructure is Frobenius compatible.
coverage: Read every section of the LaTeX source. Sec 2 (equivariant unramified eigencomplex): checked the point-object lemma (the nonzero negative-degree endomorphism built from truncations when a<b; the socle/nilpotent-scalar argument giving a 1-dimensional module), the tangent complex and H^2 vanishing, the shift elimination r=0 on f-invariant finite-type opens U_m, and the uniqueness of the eigenstructure via Hom-Künneth and a trivial centralizer. Sec 3 (lift and gluing): derived Ad(A)N=qN from A u(ζ)A^{-1}=u(ζ^q). Checked that the eigenvalues a0 q^i are distinct and that the cocharacter c commutes with A and scales N. With P=c(-1/e) and e≡-1 mod l^N, P lies in J and P exp(-eaN)P^{-1}=exp(aN). Checked the gerbe power map ζ→ζ^e together with orientation reversal giving u^{-e}, that g→Pg intertwines both inertia and Frobenius because PA=AP, and the density argument through the component-orbit lemma (semicontinuity of h^0 on the flat coarse space). Sec 4: the inertia type is φ-invariant as a group-scheme homomorphism; checked the nearby-cycle nonvanishing via extension of a modification and a henselian section, the φ^m-fixing of the slice point a2, the perverse-truncation shift bookkeeping, torus monodromy unipotence via Weyl-orbit separation, and the H_c^{2r} spectral-sequence nonvanishing. Sec 5: mixed-characteristic specialization, extension of the flag by properness, and identification of the Weil eigenvalue. Taken on trust: CT Thm 4.1/4.2, Prop 6.1/7.5, Lemmas 7.1/7.4/8.1/8.2; GR restricted equivalence; AGKRRV spectral action and Thm 8.1.4.
sibling_notes: Depends on the companion paper 'Constructible tame Hecke eigensheaves in positive characteristic' (rank247, no_gap_found) for nearby cycles, specialization detection, perverse truncation and enhancement descent. It reuses the twisted-node root calculation already checked by the rank315/rank247 branches. The new arithmetic ingredients are Frobenius-equivariant gluing through a commuting compact conjugator P=c(-1/e) and the rigidity argument for the transported skyscraper; both check out.
